## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Kerala-themed mobile open-world driving game.

## Requirements
- Kerala setting with all 14 districts and major spots.
- Malayalam and English interface copy.
- Mobile touch controls plus desktop keyboard support.
- GTA-style open-road exploration, with no real GTA/rockstar branding.

## Decisions
- Use a stylized 2D top-down canvas game.
- Start the player near Ernakulam/Fort Kochi.
- Present a district map, mission HUD, minimap, delivery objective, and travel stats.
- Use `WASD`, arrows, and touch controls for movement.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full game shell and responsive Malayalam UI.
- Implemented canvas terrain, roads, landmarks, villages, trees, and car rendering.
- Added all 14 Kerala districts and major spots.
- Added player movement, keyboard/touch controls, delivery objectives, minimap, district map, HUD, and journey tracking.
- Added start screen and mobile-specific control layout.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and browser rendering.
- Verified desktop and mobile viewport screenshots.
- Added a favicon and adjusted mobile control positioning.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue visual and gameplay polish, especially finer road placement and landmark variety.
2. Test all delivery transitions and the 14-district completion flow.
3. Add optional audio or richer Kerala environmental effects.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main page structure and overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Desktop/mobile visual styling and responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Game engine, districts, canvas rendering, movement, HUD, and missions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/check.jpg`: Initial browser screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/play.jpg`: Gameplay screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/mobile.jpg`: Mobile viewport screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/map.jpg`: District map screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game server was run with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Browser verification was performed with Playwright Chromium and SwiftShader; no hardware GPU acceleration is claimed.
- The only console error observed was an unnecessary `favicon.ico` 404, addressed by adding a data-URI favicon.
- The player was verified as starting and rendering; movement increased speed and travel distance.
